old_caption: The video captures the vibrant atmosphere of a bustling indoor shopping mall in Singapore, specifically the Hong Kong Street section at Jurong East in 2022. The scene is set on an escalator that carries viewers upward through the lively environment, showcasing a variety of shops and bright neon signs in Chinese characters. As the camera remains fixed on the escalator, viewers can see people walking around, some ascending and others descending the escalator. The shops are adorned with colorful signage, including one prominently displaying "POPULAR" and another reading "淘味行" (Tao Wei Xing) and "新明星 牛扒之家" (Xin Ming Xing Beef Steak House). The lighting is dynamic, with reflections from the neon lights adding to the energetic ambiance. The perspective highlights the diverse array of businesses and the constant movement of shoppers. The overall mood is lively and engaging, reflecting the vibrant culture and commercial activity typical of such markets.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures the vibrant atmosphere of a bustling indoor shopping mall in Singapore, specifically the Hong Kong Street section at Yuhua Market in 2022. The scene is set on an escalator that ascends through the lively environment, showcasing a variety of shops and bright neon signs in Chinese characters. As the camera moves upward, viewers can see people walking around, some ascending and others descending the escalator. The shops are adorned with colorful signage, including one prominently displaying "POPULAR" and another reading "Hong Kong Street." The camera's steady ascent provides a comprehensive view of the mall's interior, highlighting the diverse array of businesses and the constant movement of shoppers. caption: The video captures a first-person view riding down an escalator through a neon-lit mall court, with a yellow overlay reading '新加坡裕廊坊香港街 2022' at the top left. Overhead hang glowing signs—a vertical yellow-and-red placard, a green-and-red '紅珊瑚' board, a yellow '新明星' sign, and an orange 'POPULAR' banner—all drifting upward as the camera descends. A masked man in a white T-shirt stands close on the left and slides out of view, while a man leaning on the left handrail remains partly visible. On the right a masked man props himself on the railing and looks down throughout. At the bottom a person in a red shirt and beige trousers stands among shop fronts, then partly hidden behind the curving central handrail as a rack of light clothing comes into view. Glass balustrades on both sides mirror the scene, and the steady descent continues without a clear start or finish.
